pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.9
pack.summary: Release V2.4.9. 8 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Fixes a bug that could leave your Minecraft unable to start. If you installed the mod pack by hand before pointing Corvus at the folder — which the guide tells you is fine — the first update added the new mod files but could not remove the old ones, because it had no record of what was already there. Two copies of the same mod stops the game loading. Corvus now recognises the pack's own files by name, so superseded ones are removed whether or not it has a record, and it checks afterwards that only one copy of each mod is left. Your own mods are never touched: only files matching the pack's exact naming are removed, everything is backed up first, and each removal is written to the log.
